summary: Grass Knob tower in Brush Creek State Forest, Scioto County, OH; 1934 manning notice; moved beside US 23 and no longer standing.

facts.status_note: FFLOS says the tower was moved from this site to a location beside US Route 23 and is no longer standing at all

access.note: Original site lies in Brush Creek State Forest, a state forest; no source describes the spot today

visit.trail_note: Brush Creek State Forest has two bridle trails and in-season hunting (Wikipedia); no source describes the tower spot

events.note: Chillicothe Gazette, October 27, 1934: a Grass Knob Tower north of Otway would be manned by Perry Bonner of Mt. Joy. The FFLOS site records do not mention 1934, so whether it is this tower is unconfirmed
Registered on the FFLOS register September 3, 2014 as US 1558, OH 4; nominated by Mark

notes_for_editor: No build date appears in any source read, so no built event is recorded. The move date is not given in either FFLOS record, so no relocated event is recorded. The 1934 notice names a Grass Knob Tower north of Otway. Neither FFLOS site record mentions 1934, so the story does not identify it with this tower and says the link is unconfirmed. County conflict: FFLOS puts the site in Scioto County, Wikipedia puts the forest in Adams County. Not reconciled; the story says so. The FFLOS record names ODNR as administering agency; the Site #2 record names none. The Ohio Department of Natural Resources page for Brush Creek State Forest returned a 404 and was not used. Read budget: about six pages.
